summary: Empower your career with our Leadership for Women in the Workplace Training Course. Gain essential skills and confidence to lead effectively in any environment.
lede: Leadership development for women in the workplace helps emerging and experienced managers strengthen how they lead teams, projects, and organizational change. Participants work on assertive communication, confident decision-making, negotiation, and responding to bias while building emotional awareness and resilience. The course also covers influencing without formal authority, developing inclusive teams, and using mentorship and networks to support leadership goals.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for women who want to strengthen their leadership presence and influence across industries and sectors, including:
modules: Leading Change and Building a Legacy
